# Feeling Chart Analysis

## Overview
This is a **"Feeling Chart"** — an educational emotional literacy tool displaying 20 different emotions through cartoon emoji-style faces.

## Layout & Design
- **Title**: "FEELING CHART" in bold yellow text on a purple header
- **Background**: White with a purple border
- **Grid arrangement**: 5 rows × 4 columns of emoji faces
- Each emotion has a **yellow circular emoji** above a **purple label badge**

## All 20 Emotions Displayed (left to right, top to bottom)

| Row | Emotions |
|-----|----------|
| 1 | AFRAID · SAD · WORRIED · HAPPY |
| 2 | ASHAMED · DISTRACTED · EMBARRASSED · NERVOUS |
| 3 | CONFIDENT · FRUSTRATED · GUILTY · LONELY |
| 4 | EXHAUSTED · SURPRISED · SHY · CONFUSED |
| 5 | PROUD · SHOCKED · ANGRY · OVERWHELMED |

## Notable Visual Details
- **SAD**: includes a blue teardrop
- **NERVOUS**: shows sweat droplets
- **CONFIDENT**: emoji has thumbs up gesture
- **EXHAUSTED**: shows "ZZZ" sleep symbols
- **EMBARRASSED/SHY**: feature rosy red cheeks
- **ANGRY**: uniquely rendered in **red** instead of yellow
- **SHOCKED**: tongue sticking out with wide eyes

## Purpose
Designed as an **educational reference chart**, likely for children, to help identify and name emotional states.
